input.command: ls graphify-out | head; graphify query "what files use QueryCell from apps/web/lib/QueryCell.tsx" 2>&1 | head -40; echo ----; rg -l "QueryCell" --glob '!graphify-out' .

content.text:
Five files use the `QueryCell` defined in `apps/web/lib/QueryCell.tsx`. Four import it (three through the `@lib/QueryCell` alias, one by relative path) and call it. The fifth is a test that mocks it.

- `apps/web/components/apps/CalendarListContainer.tsx` renders `<QueryCell>` (line 42).
- `apps/web/components/apps/installation/EventTypeConferencingAppSettings.tsx` renders `<QueryCell>` (line 84).
- `apps/web/modules/apps/installed/[category]/installed-category-view.tsx` renders `<QueryCell>` (line 111).
- `apps/web/components/dialog/EditLocationDialog.tsx` renders `<QueryCell>` (line 270).
- `apps/web/components/dialog/__tests__/EditLocationDialog.test.tsx` mocks the module with `vi.mock` and stubs `QueryCell` with `mockImplementation`.

`packages/platform/atoms/selected-calendars/wrappers/SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx` also uses a `QueryCell`, but it imports `@calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell`. That is a separate copy at `packages/trpc/components/QueryCell.tsx`, so I left it out.

apps/web/components/apps/installation/EventTypeConferencingAppSettings.tsx
apps/web/modules/apps/installed/[category]/installed-category-view.tsx
apps/web/components/dialog/EditLocationDialog.tsx
apps/web/components/dialog/__tests__/EditLocationDialog.test.tsx
</files>
